svg.title: Figure 5. Noncircular and thin-walled sections
svg.desc: Three panels. (a) A rectangle of sides a and b in torsion: shear stress arrows along the long edges are largest at the middle of each long side and fall to zero at the corners. (b) The coefficients c1 and c2 in the formulas tau max equals T over c1 a b squared and phi equals T L over c2 a b cubed G, plotted against the aspect ratio a over b from 1 to 10: c1 rises from about 0.21 and c2 from about 0.14, and both approach one third, the thin-strip limit. (c) A thin-walled tube carries a constant shear flow q equal to tau times t around the wall.
